source.label: Annual Report 2025, consolidated financial statements, cash flow statement of the Volkswagen Group
Consolidated Financial Statements 2025, notes, cost of sales (research and development costs)
source.quote: In fiscal year 2025, the Volkswagen Group's research and development costs recognized in profit or loss amounted to €18,396 million (previous year: €17,963 million).

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. R&D: costs recognised in profit or loss (€18,396m), not total R&D costs (the Automotive Division's total was €19,412m in 2025, of which €9,343m capitalised).
